title: Interest plan updated
description: This event occurs when an interest plan is successfully updated with product interest engine.

interest_plan_id.title: Interest Plan Id
interest_plan_id.description: Unique interest plan identifier generated by Pismo.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Numerical currency code according to ISO 4217 standard.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.description: Market index used to measure the interest a value will have over time.

fixed_interest_rate.title: Fixed Interest Rate
fixed_interest_rate.description: Unchanging rate to be paid over the investments or deposits made. This means that from the moment the clients invest or deposit their money, they know exactly how much they will receive after the maturity date.

margin_rate.title: Margin Rate
margin_rate.description: Rate linked to your benchmark rate (e.g. 103% DI, 100% BOE, 90% RBI/RBA).Margin rate are in bold

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: Also known as spread, it is an incremental rate the clients will receive over the investments or deposits made.

tax_withholding.title: Tax Withholding
tax_withholding.description: Tax withholding configuration. Absent/null when there is no withholding.

fee_processing_code.title: Fee Processing Code
fee_processing_code.description: Processing code configured in the fee model in order to charge a tax, penalty or fee.

accrual_basis.title: Accrual Basis
accrual_basis.description: Method used to calculate the interest accrual (e.g. Actual/360 and Actual/365 calculate the accrual by dividing the annual interest rate by 360 or 365 days, then multiplying it by the actual number of days in a specific month).

accrual_frequency.title: Accrual Frequency
accrual_frequency.description: The frequency your interest is calculated. It can be daily, monthly, quarterly, half yearly or yearly.

capitalization_frequency.title: Capitalization Frequency
capitalization_frequency.description: This determines when the clients will have their interest paid. It can be daily, monthly, quarterly, half yearly, yearly.

interest_type.title: Interest Type
interest_type.description: Ways to calculate your interest are simple (calculated on the original deposit or investment value) and compound (calculated on the original value plus the last accumulated interest).

operation_type.title: Operation Type
operation_type.description: Operation type. Always present; inherited from the plan (defaults to CREDIT).

updated_at.title: Updated date
updated_at.description: Date the interest plan version was updated. Emitted as LocalDate.now() (date only, no time).

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Date on which the interest plan is a valid plan

interest_by_tiers.title: Interest by Tiers
interest_by_tiers.description: Tiered interest configuration. WARNING: emitted as a JSON-encoded STRING (stored as text in the domain), not a nested object. Optional: absent when not informed.

interest_thresholds.title: Interest Thresholds
interest_thresholds.description: Interest rate thresholds. WARNING: emitted as a JSON-encoded STRING, not a nested object. Optional: absent when not informed.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Additional metadata for the interest plan

division_id.title: Division ID
division_id.description: Division identifier for the interest plan

interest_base_model.title: Interest Base Model
interest_base_model.description: Model used to calculate interest. When not informed, defaults to CLOSING-BALANCE.

fixed_percentage.title: Fixed Percentage
fixed_percentage.description: Fixed percentage rate for this tax rule.

threshold_amount.title: Threshold Amount
threshold_amount.description: Amount threshold above which this tax rule applies.
